meetups.schedule: Annual conference (August)

meetups.name: Thotcon
meetups.schedule: Once every two years
meetups.description: Location is subject to change, but the previous event's is marked here. One of the original conferences held in Chicago for over a decade at this point.

meetups.name: Cyphercon
meetups.schedule: Yearly in Spring
meetups.description: CypherCon is Wisconsin’s largest technology, cybersecurity, and hacker conference, bringing together information security professionals, hackers, technology leaders, creators, artists, makers, and curious innovators.

meetups.name: BSides312
meetups.schedule: Yearly
meetups.description: BSides312 brings together security professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts for an unforgettable day of learning and networking — held the day after THOTCON, so it's easy to make a full weekend of it.

meetups.name: DEF CON Group Chicago
meetups.schedule: Monthly
meetups.description: Regional DCG meetup for DCG312

meetups.name: HackInBo
meetups.schedule: Twice yearly, Spring and Winter
meetups.description: Italian cybersecurity conference that's been going on since 2013. With speakers in Italian and English.

meetups.name: Chaos Communication Congress
meetups.schedule: Every year, starting the day after Christmas.
meetups.description: One of the largest and longest lasting cybersecurity conferences in the world. Held in Germany after the Christmas holidays until the New Year.

meetups.name: ChiBrrCon
meetups.schedule: Early February each year
meetups.description: Long running winter security conference in Chicago. Previously held on the IIT campus. It's aimed at all professionals and students a like.

meetups.name: CONFidence Conference
meetups.schedule: Late May/Early June yearly
meetups.description: One of the largest and longest running (20 years) cybersecurity conferences in Poland.

meetups.name: GrrCON
meetups.schedule: Usually held in September
meetups.description: Well established and regarded infosec conference in Michigan. Held yearly for well over a decade.

meetups.name: BSides DFW
meetups.schedule: Yearly in November
meetups.description: A regular conference in the Dallas Fort Worth area, and has been going since 2010

meetups.name: BSides Las Vegas
meetups.schedule: Yearly at about the same time as DEF CON and Blackhat
meetups.description: Probably one of the most well known of the BSides events across the world. A fixture during Hacker Summer Camp.

meetups.name: ISSA Chicago
meetups.schedule: First Thursday of the month
meetups.description: Chicago chapter of ISSA, which is very active locally and at local conferences. Regularly helps out students and people new to the field.

meetups.name: OC2600

meetups.name: Irvine Underground

meetups.description: A major Orange County security and hacking group, associated with the local 2600 group. Presenting projects is welcome and expected!
